description: List how each connected sales channel prices products, one row per channel and currency: rule null means the base price, otherwise percent, fixed and rounding are added to it. The currency null means the channel has not told the CRM its currency yet. Read-only. Use preview_channel_price_rule to see what a change would do, and get_product_pricing for one product.

platform.description: One sales channel, e.g. ebay. Omit for every connected one.

name: list_channel_price_rules
title: List channel price rules
